# Vincere Legal Marketing

> Vincere Legal Marketing is a full-service marketing partner for US law firms: consulting and intake, branding, Google Local Services Ads, SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), PPC, Meta ads, traditional media and websites. Every engagement starts with a free market plan, and results are measured in signed cases.

Contact: joe@vincerelegalmarketing.com. Book a free 30-minute strategy call at https://vincerelegalmarketing.com/#contact.

## Services

- [Consulting](https://vincerelegalmarketing.com/services/law-firm-consulting/): Law firm consulting is a hands-on review and rebuild of how a firm turns inquiries into signed clients.
- [Branding](https://vincerelegalmarketing.com/services/law-firm-branding/): Law firm branding is the strategy and identity that shape how prospective clients recognize, remember and trust a firm.
- [Local Services Ads](https://vincerelegalmarketing.com/services/local-services-ads-for-lawyers/): Local Services Ads for lawyers are Google ads that appear at the top of many local legal searches, showing the firm's name, reviews and a Google Screened badge.
- [SEO](https://vincerelegalmarketing.com/services/law-firm-seo/): SEO for law firms is the work of earning unpaid visibility in Google for searches prospective clients make, such as a practice area plus a city.
- [AEO](https://vincerelegalmarketing.com/services/law-firm-aeo/): AEO, or answer engine optimization, for law firms is the practice of making a firm's expertise easy for AI assistants to find, understand and cite.
- [PPC](https://vincerelegalmarketing.com/services/law-firm-ppc/): PPC for law firms is paid search advertising, mainly Google Search Ads, where your firm bids to appear at the top of results for queries like 'car accident lawyer near me'.
- [Meta Ads](https://vincerelegalmarketing.com/services/meta-ads-for-lawyers/): Meta ads for law firms are paid campaigns on Facebook and Instagram that reach people by location, interests and behavior rather than search keywords.
- [Traditional](https://vincerelegalmarketing.com/services/law-firm-traditional-advertising/): Traditional advertising for law firms means offline media: billboards, TV, radio, direct mail and print.
- [Websites](https://vincerelegalmarketing.com/services/law-firm-website-design/): Law firm website design is building a firm's site to earn trust, rank in search and convert visitors into consultations.

## Practice areas

- [Personal Injury marketing](https://vincerelegalmarketing.com/practice-areas/personal-injury-lawyer-marketing/): Personal injury lawyers get more clients by showing up where injured people search first, usually Google Local Services Ads, the map pack and paid search, then answering every call within minutes.
- [Criminal Defense marketing](https://vincerelegalmarketing.com/practice-areas/criminal-defense-lawyer-marketing/): Criminal defense lawyers get more clients by being visible the moment someone is arrested or charged, usually through Google Local Services Ads, paid search and the map pack, and by answering around the clock.
- [Family Law marketing](https://vincerelegalmarketing.com/practice-areas/family-law-marketing/): Family law attorneys get more clients by ranking for divorce and custody searches in their county, running Local Services Ads and targeted paid search, and converting inquiries with empathetic, fast intake.
- [Estate Planning marketing](https://vincerelegalmarketing.com/practice-areas/estate-planning-attorney-marketing/): Estate planning attorneys get more clients by combining local search visibility with education, such as seminars, webinars and plain-language guides, and by nurturing prospects over weeks or months.
- [Real Estate marketing](https://vincerelegalmarketing.com/practice-areas/real-estate-attorney-marketing/): Real estate attorneys get more clients by ranking locally for transaction and dispute searches, running paid search on high-value matters like quiet title or partition actions, and building relationships with agents, lenders and investors who send repeat work.
- [Business Law marketing](https://vincerelegalmarketing.com/practice-areas/business-lawyer-marketing/): Business lawyers get more clients by showing clear expertise in the matters owners search for, such as entity formation, contracts, partnership disputes and buying or selling a business.
- [Litigation marketing](https://vincerelegalmarketing.com/practice-areas/litigation-attorney-marketing/): Litigation attorneys get more clients by demonstrating trial credibility where decision makers look: search results, AI assistant answers, attorney profiles and referrals from other lawyers.
- [Employment Law marketing](https://vincerelegalmarketing.com/practice-areas/employment-lawyer-marketing/): Employment lawyers get more clients by ranking and advertising for specific claims like wrongful termination, discrimination, retaliation and unpaid overtime, then screening inquiries quickly for merit, damages and deadlines.
- [Immigration marketing](https://vincerelegalmarketing.com/practice-areas/immigration-lawyer-marketing/): Immigration lawyers get more clients by showing up where families search, often in Spanish and other languages, and by answering fast in that language.
- [Bankruptcy marketing](https://vincerelegalmarketing.com/practice-areas/bankruptcy-attorney-marketing/): Bankruptcy attorneys get more clients by ranking for local debt relief searches, running tightly controlled search ads around urgent triggers like foreclosure and garnishment, and answering calls fast with a judgment-free intake process.
- [Workers' Compensation marketing](https://vincerelegalmarketing.com/practice-areas/workers-compensation-lawyer-marketing/): Workers' compensation lawyers get more clients by targeting the moments workers look for help: claim denials, stopped checks, light duty disputes and pressure to settle.
- [Medical Malpractice marketing](https://vincerelegalmarketing.com/practice-areas/medical-malpractice-lawyer-marketing/): Medical malpractice lawyers get more cases by publishing authoritative content on specific injuries like birth injuries, surgical errors and misdiagnosis, running search ads narrowly targeted to serious harm, and building referral relationships with other firms.
- [DUI / DWI marketing](https://vincerelegalmarketing.com/practice-areas/dui-lawyer-marketing/): DUI lawyers get more clients by dominating local search and the map pack for DUI and DWI terms, running search ads around the clock, and answering every call live, day or night.
- [Intellectual Property marketing](https://vincerelegalmarketing.com/practice-areas/intellectual-property-attorney-marketing/): Intellectual property attorneys get more clients by publishing expert content on patents, trademarks and copyrights, ranking for national and industry-specific searches, and building authority that AI assistants cite.
- [Tax Law marketing](https://vincerelegalmarketing.com/practice-areas/tax-attorney-marketing/): Tax attorneys get more clients by targeting urgent IRS and state tax problems like levies, liens, audits and unfiled returns, and by clearly showing why an attorney differs from a tax relief company.
